verdict.justification: The project aims to develop an educational web application focused on children with dyslexia from the Centro de Educación Especial Tuluá (CEET). The abstract mentions Objectivos Virtuales de Aprendizaje (OVA) and Sistema de Gestión de Aprendizaje (LMS), which are e-learning artifacts. No other term fits as well given the context.
keywords_cited: Tecnología de la información y de la comunicación. TIC
